picks.title: UAE says Iran attacked ADNOC vessel with missile in Strait of Hormuz
picks.summary: The UAE condemned what it called an Iranian missile strike on a tanker linked to its state oil company as it transited the Strait of Hormuz, accusing Tehran of "acts of piracy" — a fresh escalation as the wider US-Iran standoff drags on.
flags: Iran has not confirmed the attack; account so far is UAE-sourced only

picks.title: Russian attacks kill 4 in Kyiv and surrounding region as air defenses fall short
picks.summary: Overnight Russian missile and drone strikes killed four people including a child in and around Kyiv, with Zelensky warning that dwindling Patriot interceptor stocks are letting more of the barrage through.

picks.bucket: US as the world sees it
picks.title: Bluster and backdown have turned Iran war into Trump's own Groundhog Day
picks.summary: Five months into his war of choice against Iran, Trump keeps threatening devastating bombardment then backing down for renewed talks — a repeating cycle international analysts say reflects a poor read of his adversary and is inviting ridicule abroad.

picks.title: Fiesta sorpresa para Carlos Beltrán en el Coca-Cola Music Hall: "Me alegra que sea en vida"
picks.origTitle: Fiesta sorpresa para Carlos Beltrán en el Coca-Cola Music Hall: "Me alegra que sea en vida"
picks.summary: Puerto Rico threw a surprise celebration for baseball legend Carlos Beltrán at the Coca-Cola Music Hall following his recent Hall of Fame induction; Beltrán said he was glad to see the tributes while he's still alive to enjoy them.

picks.title: ByteDance trains massive AI model in bid to rival Anthropic
picks.summary: TikTok owner ByteDance is training a roughly 10-trillion-parameter model as it pushes to compete directly with frontier labs like Anthropic.

picks.title: Report: White House drafting executive order linking vaccines and autism
picks.summary: The administration is reportedly drafting an executive order asserting a vaccine-autism link, a claim unsupported by scientific evidence, drawing warnings about both public-health and political fallout.
flags: Scientific consensus does not support a vaccine-autism link; expect pushback from health authorities

picks.title: AI chatbots have failed people in crisis. Can that be fixed?
picks.summary: Clinicians and researchers argue AI companies need to be more transparent with their safety data after multiple documented cases of chatbots mishandling users in mental-health crises.

picks.title: New Amazon Data Center Is Set to Have the Most Polluting Power Plant in the U.S.
picks.summary: A new Amazon data center in Texas is being paired with what would be the most polluting power plant in the country, spotlighting the environmental cost of the AI buildout.
flags: Contested by Amazon on emissions figures per some reporting

picks.title: 'Truth' in an Age of A.I.
picks.summary: Former TV news producer Steve Rosenbaum joins Josh Szeps to discuss whether AI can help re-establish shared facts after social media fractured them, or will just make truth slipperier — drawing on his book "The Future of Truth."

picks.title: BLOCKADE COUNTDOWN: What's the End Game?
picks.summary: Former NSC Middle East director Steven Simon breaks down the logic of Trump's Iran blockade, what leverage Iran still has, and how the standoff is likely to end.
